about: Ratchet of server/tests/app-unpublished-access.test.js: the raw app lookups (getApps(, getAppsForUser(, getAppForUserById() left in server/routes (without server/routes/admin) and server/services/chat. It may only shrink. The app a request may run comes from configCache.getAppForRequest(appId, req.user). Personal apps (increment 2) are not in the config cache, so none of these lookups finds one; `personal` says what each site answers for an ID of the personal shape. The app a chat request may run comes from resolveAppForChat (server/services/userApps/resolveApp.js), which asks getAppForRequest for an admin app.

server/routes/chat/feedbackRoutes.js.why: getApps(true): reads only features.feedback of the app a feedback entry names, to refuse feedback for an app that switched it off.
server/routes/chat/feedbackRoutes.js.personal: Resolved through resolveAppForChat: feedback is taken from a caller who can use the app and answers 404 for everyone else (user-apps-run-paths.test.js).

server/routes/chatShares.js.why: getApps(true): name, colour and icon of the app a shared chat belongs to, for the share viewer, who may have no app list at all.
server/routes/chatShares.js.personal: Stores no app name, colour or icon for the shared chat, as for a deleted app (design 7.6). No default is applied and nothing of the personal app is read.

server/routes/exports.js.why: Two helpers that take an app id and no user. Not converted on purpose (plan 5.4): an export from the test chat of an unpublished app uses the default export settings.
server/routes/exports.js.personal: Not converted: an export from a chat of a personal app uses the default export settings, as for an unknown app. A personal app cannot set export settings, so the default is also what it would say.

server/routes/generalRoutes.js.why: GET /api/apps is the list (getAppsForUser): it never holds an unpublished app, for admins too. GET /api/apps/:appId answers 500 while the published list cannot be read, as before; the app itself comes from getAppForRequest.
server/routes/generalRoutes.js.personal: GET /api/apps without scope never lists one; with scope it lists personal apps only (listUserAppsFor). GET /api/apps/:appId answers through readUserAppFor, or 404.

server/routes/mcpAppRoutes.js.why: resolveMcpApp: the app of an MCP App view, looked up in the caller's published apps. Not converted (not in plan 5.4): the view of an MCP tool does not open in the test chat of an unpublished app.
server/routes/mcpAppRoutes.js.personal: Not found: the view of an MCP tool does not open in a chat of a personal app.

server/routes/promptRoutes.js.why: Whether a prompt may be bound to an app its author can open. Published apps only, on purpose (plan 5.4: the prompt routes are not converted).
server/routes/promptRoutes.js.personal: Not found: a prompt cannot be bound to a personal app.

server/routes/scheduledTasks.js.why: The tools an app offers a scheduled task, and the upload policy of a task's app. A scheduled task never runs an unpublished app, on purpose (plan 5.4).
server/routes/scheduledTasks.js.personal: Not found: a scheduled task never runs a personal app (design 7.5; user-apps-run-paths.test.js).

server/routes/voiceRoutes.js.why: Not a lookup by id: a loop over the caller's apps that collects the voices they may request. Stays a list on purpose (plan 5.4): read-aloud in the test chat of an unpublished app uses the model's voices.
server/routes/voiceRoutes.js.personal: Not a lookup by ID. A personal app adds no voices.

server/routes/workflow/workflowRoutes.js.why: The workflow chat route. Not converted on purpose (plan 5.4): it answers for an unpublished app as for an unknown id.
server/routes/workflow/workflowRoutes.js.personal: Answers as for an unknown ID (design 7.5; user-apps-run-paths.test.js).

server/services/chat/RequestBuilder.js.why: prepareChatRequest without resolvedApp: scheduled tasks, apps called as tools and the inference API keep getting 'not found' for an unpublished app (plan 5.4).
server/services/chat/RequestBuilder.js.personal: Without the app the chat route resolved it answers APP_NOT_FOUND (user-apps-run-paths.test.js).

server/services/chat/appToolsGateway.js.why: getApps(true) with its own check (isAppAvailable): an app that is not published is neither offered as a tool nor run as one, and the refusal says so.
server/services/chat/appToolsGateway.js.personal: Neither offered nor run as a tool (user-apps-run-paths.test.js).

server/services/run/assemble/fromApp.js.why: assembleFromApp: the prompt template of an app the run service runs headless (an app called as a tool, through MCP or by an A2A agent). Published apps only, on purpose (plan 5.4); it moved here from ChatService.invokeAppInternal.
server/services/run/assemble/fromApp.js.personal: The run service answers APP_NOT_FOUND: a personal app runs neither as a tool nor headless (user-apps-run-paths.test.js).
